name: Guess The Tree
description: This is an interactive problem. Misuki has chosen a secret tree with $$$n$$$ nodes, indexed from $$$1$$$ to $$$n$$$, and asked you to guess it by using queries of the following type: "? a b" — Misuki will tell you which node $$$x$$$ minimizes $$$|d(a,x) - d(b,x)|$$$, where $$$d(x,y)$$$ is the distance between nodes $$$x$$$ and $$$y$$$. If more than one such node exists, Misuki will tell you the one which minimizes $$$d(a,x)$$$. Find out the structure of Misuki's secret tree using at most $$$15n$$$ queries!
input_specification: Each test consists of multiple test cases. The first line contains a single integer $$$t$$$ ($$$1 \le t \le 200$$$) — the number of test cases. Each test case consists of a single line with an integer $$$n$$$ ($$$2 \le n \le 1000$$$), the number of nodes in the tree. It is guaranteed that the sum of $$$n$$$ across all test cases does not exceed $$$1000$$$.
approach_summary: Design an adaptive query strategy maintaining uncertainty bounds. Halve candidate space or probe tree centroids using at most the allowed query budget.
